Here are some relevant sources that discuss AI accountability systems designed for individuals struggling with consistency and performance routines:

1. **Pensy** - An AI accountability partner that helps users remember their goals, check in regularly, and celebrate achievements. It focuses on maintaining motivation and tracking progress over time. [pensy.ai](https://pensy.ai/)

2. **Consistency Calendar** - This platform allows users to create a gamified execution calendar for various goals, helping them track habits and progress while providing flexibility for life’s unpredictability. [consistencycalendar.com](https://consistencycalendar.com/)

3. **Accountability Coach AI** - This AI tool helps users define their goals using the SMART framework, creates actionable plans, and provides regular check-ins to keep users accountable. [accountabilitycoach.ai](https://accountabilitycoach.ai/)
